name: The Fish-Sign Encounter (February 20, 1974)
summary: A pharmacy delivery girl wearing a Christian fish-symbol necklace catches sunlight; PKD reports a sudden recognition that he is a first-century Christian named Thomas and that the world around him is fake.
description: On February 20, 1974, PKD had had impacted wisdom teeth removed and was on sodium pentothal recovery. A young woman from the pharmacy delivered a pain medication. She wore a small gold necklace with the early-Christian *ichthys* (fish) symbol. The sun caught the necklace and reflected light into PKD's eyes. He reports an instantaneous *anamnesis* — a remembering — that he is in fact a first-century Roman Christian named Thomas, that the apostolic age is the real time, and that the surrounding 1974 California is a stage-managed simulation. This event is the canonical entry-point of what PKD subsequently called 2-3-74.

pkd_interpretations.interpretation: I have been addressed by Christ; the apostolic age has overlaid the present, revealing it as fallen.
What I experienced was phylogenic anamnesis — racial-memory recall — possibly via a drug-mediated mechanism, of a previous incarnation.
The fish sign was the trigger for an information transfer from VALIS, a non-human intelligence in geosynchronous orbit.
Horselover Fat experiences this; the novel records the event without resolving its ontology.

scholar_interpretations.interpretation: Jackson's 1999 dissertation reads the fish-sign moment as the foundational hermeneutic puzzle PKD spent the rest of his life trying to solve.
Davis reads it as exemplary California-visionary anamnesis in the lineage of Esalen and the human-potential movement, with a specifically gnostic-hermeticist content.
Arnold's psychiatric reading: post-anesthetic confusion plus possible TLE mediating an episode of derealization.
McKee's *Pink Beams of Light* (2004) treats this as the canonical PKD theophany — analogous to Augustine's tolle lege moment.

primary_sources.excerpt: Multiple Exegesis segments 1974-1981 return to the fish sign.

primary_quote: It appeared — in vivid fire, with shining colors and balanced patterns — and released me from every thrall, inner and outer.
contradiction_zone: yes — the 2-3-74 events are the central dispute zone in PKD studies
pkd_doubt_evidence: PKD repeatedly considers and dismisses drug-induced and TLE explanations across the Exegesis.
